scope: worksRotate Animator timing only; read-only cached-source inspection, no browser run.
conclusion: Confirmed: worksRotate nominal duration 1 second accumulates GL deltaTime capped at 1/30 second per frame. It does not use an independent wall-clock timer. Sustained frame rates below 30 fps therefore lengthen the transition in wall-clock time.

localCorrespondence.assessment: These capped-delta timing operations match the original worksRotate clock model. Do not reject this behavior merely because a software-rendered run takes more than one wall-clock second.

limits: No conclusion about other animation channels or full source parity is made. Animator has an i || .016 fallback for a zero/falsy input; the positive-delta low-fps conclusion is unaffected.

hoverEulerOrder.status: Confirmed source order; this is an earlier design-description error, not merely a capture sampling limitation.
hoverEulerOrder.conclusion: With a cached pointer event and loaded meshes, each GL frame calls MainLogo.hover before MainLogo.update. Pointer residual is added to temporary Euler first; then MainLogo Animator advances; then the resulting Euler is multiplied by 1-dt. The new residual is therefore damped in the same frame.
orderedSteps: MainLogo.hover reads worksRotate from before this frame’s MainLogo Animator update, then adds x/y pointer residual to temporary Euler.
GL.update calls scene.update with capped GL deltaTime.
MainLogo.update advances its Animator with that deltaTime.
MainLogo.update multiplies the already modified Euler x/y by 1-deltaTime, then rebuilds the mouse quaternion.
Subsequent base/scroll rotation and return-to-origin use the updated Animator value.

excerpts.role: Later in the same GL.update, scene.update gets capped dt
MainLogo.hover reads pre-update worksRotate and adds residual
MainLogo.update advances Animator, then decays Euler and rebuilds mouse quaternion

recurrence.notation: rx/ry are the residual velocities read by MainLogo.hover; m is its radius/config weight; w_before is worksRotate before MainLogo.update; dt is capped GL delta.

localReviewed.assessment: The reviewed local implementation advances worksRotate and damps old Euler before adding new residual. Its order differs from the cached original. Correcting only the prose limitation would leave a source-parity deviation.

hoverEulerOrder.scope: Only ordering in this worksRotate/pointer rotation chain is reviewed. No application or SYSTEM edits, no browser capture. Existing timing evidence remains unchanged.
